purpose: Formalize the best safe R-FOREGROUND-2 pressure-test policy as an auditable online foreground smoke candidate on the validated R-ATTACK-0B replay.
truth_boundary: Controlled truth metadata is evaluation-only and must be attached after policy assignment.
candidate_boundary: candidate_flag, candidate_reasons, matched_rule_count, and legacy final labels are not policy features.
online_training_split_boundary: Online foreground compression and offline training/evaluation sample construction are separate tracks. Hard negatives, controls, and mixed rows may be operationally suppressed online, but their labeled rows must remain available for a later offline training/evaluation pool.
qualification_boundary: R-FOREGROUND-2 showed path1_pressure_test reached the current compression target with zero controlled attack suppression, but it was a pressure test. R-FOREGROUND-3 reruns the same logic as a single named policy and produces full assignment artifacts plus qualification audits before any learning or production claim.

assignment_states.protected_foreground: Retained because clean evidence or semantic novelty indicates downstream risk.
assignment_states.gray_retained: Retained because current evidence is insufficient for safe operational suppression.
assignment_states.operational_background_suppressed: Suppressed from downstream online workload; not a benign label.

future_targets.note: The stretch target is not binding for R-FOREGROUND-3; it becomes a later optimization target after larger attack coverage, historical replay, and poisoning/evasion scenarios.

allowed_policy_features: window recurrence and rarity features derived from event fields
community evidence state and well-known community flags
forbidden_claims: R-FOREGROUND-3 proves stealth or poisoning/evasion robustness
